RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

The panel's gender composition is not evidence of discrimination; panels typically reflect departmental availability and leadership structure. While unconscious affinity bias cannot be completely ruled out in subjective assessments, leadership appointments heavily weigh client relationships, commercial acumen, and interpersonal fit alongside technical experience. Eight years with a chartered licence meets the core qualification threshold for many senior roles. 

Raising sex discrimination without concrete documentation will severely damage your professional reputation and burn bridges with the firm. Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring about your requested feedback, framing it around professional development and learning what competencies or business-development capabilities separated the final candidates.
